title: System
description: A piece of equipment or infrastructure that personnel (Roles) interact with during mission execution — an aircraft, a communications system, a security/access-control system, an airdrop mechanism. Deliberately representative, not a real fielded system's actual specifications — see AGENTS.md Section 3, the classification boundary. Systems are nodes in the mission execution interaction network alongside Roles, C2Nodes, and Organizations (see Interaction).

commsLink.description: For a Communications-, SecurityAccessControl-, or WeatherSystem-type System: whether it carries verbal or digital traffic, its medium, and — if digital — its protocol and message format. Omitted for Systems that are not themselves a communications channel (e.g. an Aircraft, AirdropMechanism, or MedicalEquipment).
